site.audience: leisure and business travelers seeking accommodations, flights, car rentals, and experiences worldwide

brief.title: StayQuest — Find deals for any season
brief.one_liner: A comprehensive travel platform offering hotels, flights, car rentals, vacation packages, and local attractions at the best prices worldwide.
brief.goal: Enable travelers to search, compare, and book accommodations, transportation, vacation packages, and experiences with confidence through trusted reviews, free cancellation, and loyalty rewards.

pages.objective: Main landing page showcasing search functionality, seasonal deals, property types, destination recommendations, and featured accommodations to drive bookings.
Vacation packages page allowing users to search and book bundled flight + hotel deals with highlighted popular beach and resort destinations.
Car rental search page with location/date inputs, popular rental brands, FAQ section, and destination-based rental pricing information.
Attractions and experiences discovery page with search, recommended activities, nearby destinations, and categorized things to do across global cities.

interactions.trigger: Click on trip planner category tabs (Festivals & Events, Theme Parks, Beaches & Relaxation, etc.)
interactions.expected: Tab switches active state and displays corresponding destination cards for the selected travel vibe

interactions.trigger: Click left/right arrows on unique properties carousel
interactions.expected: Carousel scrolls horizontally to reveal more property cards

interactions.trigger: Click on Popular with travelers tabs (Domestic cities, International cities, Regions, Countries, Places to stay)
interactions.expected: Tab content switches to show corresponding list of popular destinations or accommodation types

interactions.trigger: Enter destination, select check-in/check-out dates, set guests, click Search
interactions.expected: Search form validates inputs and initiates accommodation search

interactions.trigger: Select radio buttons for package type (Hotel + Flight, Hotel + Flight + Car, Flight + Car, Hotel + Car)
interactions.expected: Search form fields update to reflect selected package combination
Accordion expands to reveal the answer for the clicked question and collapses others

interactions.trigger: Click on destination category tabs (Cities in the US, Airports in the US, Regions, Cities worldwide, Airports worldwide)
interactions.expected: Tab content switches to show corresponding rental location listings

interactions.trigger: Click on region tabs (Europe, North America, Asia, Africa, Oceania, etc.)
interactions.expected: Destination grid updates to show cities and activity counts for the selected region

interactions.trigger: Click on activity category tabs (Tours, City tours, Museums, Entertainment and tickets, etc.)
interactions.expected: List of popular activities updates to show items matching the selected category

data_display.description: Four trust badges highlighting key platform benefits: free cancellation, review count, property count, and customer support
Grid of popular US destinations with property counts
Carousel of unique property cards with name, location, rating, review count, and price
Weekend deal cards showing hotel names, locations, ratings, original and discounted prices for 2-night stays
Horizontal list of highly-rated apartment and home properties with ratings, review counts, and starting prices
Popular vacation package destinations with country and property count
Three benefit highlights for booking vacation packages
Logo grid of popular rental car company partners
City-based car rental destination cards with location count and average daily price
Three trust badges for car rental service: multilingual support, free cancellation policy, and verified reviews
Grid of nearby destination cards with city images and activity counts
Regional destination grid showing European cities with activity counts, switchable by continent tabs
Three value propositions for the attractions booking service
